Callout.Name: Catalytic Converter Theft
Callout.Message: Person under a parked car with a saw.
Callout.Advisory: One male, car jacked up, no owner present.

Script.Line: I am not cutting anything. I am looking, that is all.
It is my van. Mine. That is why I am under it.
The saw is for work. I am a builder.

Lines.Approach: He has it up on a jack and he is under it with a saw. Owner is not coming.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
